title: Ratio, Direct and Inverse Proportion
seo_title: Ratio and Proportion – JSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Simplify ratios; share quantities in a given ratio; solve problems on direct and inverse proportion. (summary of the NERDC JSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 maths worksheets on ratio and proportion: simplifying ratios, sharing in a ratio, direct proportion, inverse proportion and recipes. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Direct: both go up. Inverse: one up, one down.
key_sub: Find the value of one part.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Simplify a ratio by dividing by the HCF.
  • Direct proportion: y = kx. If x doubles, y doubles.
  • Inverse proportion: y = k ÷ x. If x doubles, y halves.

Examples

Example

Share ₦45,000 in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4

9 parts, one part = ₦5,000

Answer: ₦10,000, ₦15,000, ₦20,000

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Dividing by the number of peopleDivide by the total number of parts.
Using direct proportion for workers and timeIt is inverse.
Ratios with different unitsChange to the same unit.

items.e: 77 cats is 7 parts, so 1 part = 11. Dogs: 3 × 11 = 33.

items.q: The ratio of red beads to blue beads is 8 : 3. There are 35 more red beads than blue beads. How many beads are there altogether?
items.e: The difference is 8 − 3 = 5 parts = 35, so 1 part = 7. Total = 11 parts = 77.

2 workers can weed a farm in 3 days. How many days will 6 workers take, working at the same rate?
items.e: Total work = 2 × 3 = 6 worker-days. 6 ÷ 6 = 1 day. More workers take fewer days.
